bullets.text: HRC price +marginal WoW to Rs63.8K/t (+10% since end-July); domestic premium to import parity widened to ~3% vs ~1% last week.
bullets.source: Morgan Stanley — PULSE: India Materials: India Steel Tracker

detail.summary: Morgan Stanley stays In-Line on Indian steel: good demand plus seasonal-maintenance-driven destocking and the safeguard duty are supporting prices and spreads; medium term it stays constructive on China anti-involution and government support, expecting steel stocks to keep outperforming over the next 12 months.
points: HRC Rs63.8K/t, +10% since end-July, marginally higher WoW

bullets.text: India secured a 1.9MT steel export quota to the EU under its FTA, total access expected to reach 2.8MT; CBAM burden remains.

detail.summary: Kotak's ESG wrap frames the EU quota as a partial CBAM offset for Indian steel exporters, set against the UK's own CBAM taking effect January 2027 and broader domestic decarbonisation spend from Coal India and NLC India.
points: 1.9MT steel export quota secured to EU under FTA
Total EU access expected to reach 2.8MT
CBAM burden remains despite the quota
UK CBAM secondary legislation finalized, effective 1 Jan 2027

bullets.text: 30 Sep, 2pm IST: BofA webcast with ex-Coal India director on coal gasification import-substitution and execution risk.

bullets.text: JPM stays UW on KPIT (PT Rs550): SDV client cuts (~25% of revenue) hurt growth; guides 2Q flat, 3Q growth, 4Q strong, 18% exit margin.

detail.summary: JPM's channel check with KPIT's IR head found multiple top clients deprioritizing software-defined-vehicle spend, which KPIT plans to offset via account mining, new passenger-vehicle clients and commercial-vehicle expansion into new geographies; JPM stays Underweight given the tough EU auto environment.

FIIs bought $0.4bn equities, YTD outflow now $25.4bn

bullets.text: Government set 2HFY27 gross borrowing at Rs7.86tn; Kotak expects 10Y G-Sec 6.85-7.25% and 25bp RBI hikes in Oct and Dec.
